headline: Linn Mercy Heaviest as Weathered Expanse Works Change Hands
war_summary: The heaviest fighting has shifted to Linn Mercy since the morning edition, where nine Colonial works and a single Warden work flank one unclaimed post. Five events were logged there in the last two hours and twenty-two across the day, with two-hour casualties past three thousand on both sides combined and the latest clash reported as this edition went to press. Weathered Expanse has swung sharply: four works now stand under Colonial colors where the earlier report found none, alongside three Warden and two unclaimed posts, seven events falling in two hours. Palantine Berm remains the busiest sector by the day's count, fifty events and thirteen in two hours, its works dividing three Warden to four Colonial. Marban Hollow's Checkpoint Bua has gone quiet these two hours after a busy day, and Nevish Line logged only one event near Grief Mother. Gutter likewise rests after overnight clashes at Suojus. Mooring County, wholly Warden, counted seventeen events in the day but none in six hours. Thirty-four towns remain the mark for victory.
